title: John Casimir's band and its players
summary: Allen mentions seeing John Casimir; De De struggles to name his bandmates, recalling a bass player called Big Red.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: I saw John today on the bus. He got on the bus.
John Casimir. John Casimir. Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah. I told him I'm coming down to the street. Yeah.
My old friend. In fact, I mean all the boys.
Who worked with you when you were in John's band?
Wee. It's been hard to mention all the folks. Who cares? Nine pieces sometimes, you know, on the street. I lived there, but there were so many. I don't know.
You know myself who was John's band? I don't forget them all. I'm trying to remember.
I remember Red on the base. I don't know what become here. Who's Big Red? I always call him Big Red. I don't know. I always call him Red. All I know is the big red skin.
Yeah. What does he work with? He had worked with John. No, but I mean does he work for Western Union or somewhere? Do you know?

I don't know what he's doing now. I don't know what he's doing now. I know he did other work, you know, side-lockers. He played most of the music. You know, most of the side-lockers. He wasn't regular enough. He had some other regular work. I don't know what kind of working boys are there.
